svg.aria-label: pyrox on the GeoStack role ladder: the ensemble runners as algorithms, the bases your models subclass, the observation models and the fitted ensembles as models, the ensemble runner classes as strategies, the verbs that make a site and hold one draw across calls as primitives, and two site descriptors as structures; NumPyro sits beside the ladder as the floor every site is handed to, with ensemble_init as setup.
